rule: AF1/AF2/AF4 (A′#4) — the two human prerequisites + the first live paid-key parity run are DISCHARGED on a real screen / real keys as the Operator's own, or the sprint STOPS here as the honest ALPHA BLOCKER. The deferral budget was spent two sprints ago; this is where it comes due. An agent can DRIVE flows programmatically but CANNOT SIT the Operator's real-screen session, and does not hold the Operator's paid keys (LN5). This session is agent-executed → the three are recorded OWED-OPERATOR-GATED, never simulated.

AF1_IN2_operator_session.owed: the Operator's real-screen session, recorded as the Operator's own
operatorChecklist: run ./organon.sh setup as a brand-new user: paste one free key (masked), see live validation, see the Google trains-on-prompts privacy flag, confirm .env is chmod 600
./organon.sh launch; open two different pools' Stamp drawers: the lineage lines (source · REAL/SAMPLE · as-of · N · series hash) are visibly DISTINCT, not near-identical
toggle Simple vs Pro register on one Ask answer: the two read differently and both stay grounded
open a large multi-pool COMPARE: the answer is not clipped mid-sentence (the truncation mark appears if capped)
run ./organon.sh telemetry --disclosure, then --accept, set ORGANON_TELEMETRY=1, browse, and confirm ./organon.sh telemetry --show lists ONLY the manifest fields (never a key/address/prompt)
read GET /postmortems (or the export): confirm every re-score cell is SAMPLE-labeled and the verdicts match the engine
break .env on purpose, run ./organon.sh doctor: the fault is named with its cure
AF1_IN2_operator_session.recordedResult: PENDING — the Operator records the session outcome here before the invites go out; until then an OPEN ALPHA BLOCKER, not a silent gap

AF2_IN4_a11y.owed: the real browser/AT/viewport accessibility pass on a real screen (OBSERVED, not only DOM-asserted/contrast-COMPUTED, which the tree already carries)
operatorChecklist: Tab through the Shelf → a card → the Reality Check → the Ask form: focus order sane, focus ring visible, no keyboard trap
run a screen reader (VoiceOver ⌘F5 / NVDA) over one Reality Check: verdict + axis rows announced meaningfully; the SAMPLE/UNVERIFIED state is spoken, not silent
narrow to a 375px mobile viewport: no clipped COMPARE, no horizontal scroll on the verdict block
confirm every pass/fail cue has a non-color signal (word/icon), not color alone
AF2_IN4_a11y.recordedResult: PENDING — the Operator records PASS/FAIL per line before the invites go out; until then an OPEN ALPHA BLOCKER

AF4_live_paid_parity.owed: the FIRST live paid-key parity run: a real paid model key + a real DeFiLlama-Pro key under the Operator's hand → the full shelf's scorecard + Stamp verdicts BYTE-IDENTICAL vs keyless (the split's central promise, tested live), or the honest gap recorded
AF4_live_paid_parity.hermeticStatus: PROVEN HERMETICALLY (S48) — zero/free/paid profiles yield byte-identical verdicts (fingerprint cc7e5e5a…, positive-controlled); the live run is the real-world confirmation the hermetic mock stands in for
operatorProcedure: with a real paid model key + AI_PAID_TIER=1 and a real DEFILLAMA_PRO_API_KEY set, run: bun run script/honesty/capability-parity.ts (or the shelf verdict dump)
diff the full shelf's verdicts + the Stamp verdict against a keyless run: they MUST be byte-identical
the 7-module verdict-path hash set + the parity differential run UNCHANGED under the live paid profile; a moved verdict is a Halt, not a loosened test
AF4_live_paid_parity.recordedResult: PENDING — the Operator records BYTE-IDENTICAL or the honest gap; until then the live promise is asserted-hermetically, owed-live

handoffConsequence: Because AF1/AF2/AF4 are OWED-OPERATOR-GATED (not agent-dischargeable — LN5), the probe verdict in the final marker is PROBE-ARMED / READY-PENDING-OPERATOR: every machine-checkable gate is green in both repos (pins·findings·telemetry·artifact·kill-criterion·red-team), the kill-criterion is pre-registered, and the ONLY things between here and the invites are the Operator's own eyes, the Operator's a11y pass, and one live paid-key diff. This is the honest state A′#4 demands — recorded as a BLOCKER on the human/live steps, never waved through a third time.
